# RetailFlow instructions for GitHub Copilot

The canonical repository contract is [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Before substantial work, read [`doc/README.md`](../doc/README.md) and [`doc/10-open-items/Production-Gaps-and-Decision-Backlog.md`](../doc/10-open-items/Production-Gaps-and-Decision-Backlog.md).

Treat source code, migrations, tests, and CI as evidence of current implementation. Treat approved requirements and Accepted ADRs as intended behavior. Never conflate Product Host with isolated PoCs, or Proposed/Target with implemented. Do not change accepted decisions silently, invent test evidence, or close findings without traceability. Preserve tenant isolation, security boundaries, architecture, and scope. Update relevant documentation and registers at task close.
